notes: Whole-app cleanup: everything is tidied into comfortable, clearly-labeled cards, so each thing sits where you'd expect to find it.
In Possible Hours the order is now: My schedule, Suggest my work hours, the week planner, Break calendar, then your Work log — with roomier buttons and spacing everywhere.
Nothing about your numbers or how anything calculates has changed — same pay-stub math, same saved data, just easier to find your way around.
